## Personality

Allan is guided by a strong sense of moral purpose. She believes that doing good in the world should be the primary objective in all endeavors.

## History

Mrs. Allan moved to [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) with her husband, the new minister, after having grown up as a mischievous girl who was once a dunce at geometry. Shortly after her arrival, she visited [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) for tea, where she kindly comforted a mortified [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) after the girl unwittingly served her a layer cake flavored with anodyne liniment. Following the incident, Mrs. Allan invited [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to show her around the flower garden and later hosted her for a wonderful tea afternoon at the manse.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P0](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER XXI. ## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/allan--anne-shirley.md)

[Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) holds a wholehearted affection for Mrs. Allan, who serves as her beloved Sunday-school teacher. Their bond deepens after Mrs. Allan graciously comforts [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) when a layer cake baked for tea is accidentally ruined with liniment, inviting her to show her flower garden instead. Mrs. Allan further cements this friendship by inviting [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to the manse for an enjoyable afternoon tea, leaving [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) thrilled and deeply fond of her.

- Friend of — wholehearted affection for her Sunday-school teacher  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P6](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0006), [v1 CHAPTER XXIII.
